_comment: Water Phase0 authority contract, owner-approved implementation direction 2026-09-06. This file does not itself implement replication or grant any flags. Use the existing session, ledger, encounter host and portable character architecture; tests must prove each row with real peers.

skills._comment: XP, reveal and candy changes belong to the trainer. Missing legacy data starts at zero, with reveal inferred only from legitimately reached later realms.

swim_stone._comment: Shared Alpha resolution fans out one durable entitlement to eligible participants; later eligible arrivals claim from resolved Stone, not a respawned boss.

skill_candy._comment: The first world pickup claimant owns the item under existing pickup rules. Spending cannot affect another character; full tier must fit before item removal.

swim_pose._comment: Index only describes current party slot in the same atomic character snapshot. Persistent mount resource is on the creature instance, so rearranging party cannot transfer endurance.

mount_stamina._comment: Fraction clamped 0..1, capacity comes from species config. Dedicated traversal resource, never combat energy. Each duplicate species keeps its own value.

entry_key._comment: Old Cloudreach reward is migrated by Stormwood before Water sees it. Never accept the old key merely by matching its string.

entry_unlock._comment: Every peer can use an opened world gate. Key spending and unlock share one delta.

alpha._comment: Resolution and reward attribution follow one shared encounter. A successful catch and defeat cannot independently grant two rewards.

relic._comment: 10 percent incoming damage reduction, owner settled and tunable. Preserve existing personal relic ownership vs world ceremony semantics and single-active-power selection.

checks: Stormwood finale granted the Water key
water_unlock_gate._comment: No pair of independently submitted set_world_flag calls; the game must never save between spending a key and opening its gate. Realm on record is explicit, never host local realm.

checks: personal ingredient proof under existing portable-inventory trust model
water_dock_action._comment: Never accept arbitrary client flag ids or a client claimed completion. Existing movement and inventory ownership remains intact; extend typed intentions for consequential Water state.

checks: typed net_catching_level clamped through PlayerSkills to configured cap
reliable on-change replication and spawn snapshot
skills_summary._comment: Portable characters are owner-authored in the existing game. Send only Catching level, the sole skill the host needs for arbitration; XP and other skill levels remain private. Reliable on-change proxy replication orders updates. The host derives the capped bonus, ignores any bonus in a throw intent, and exclusively rolls the catch. Do not read unpopulated Game.players.

trainer_proxy._comment: Owner simulates ordinary traversal like ground movement; every peer receives swimming and drowning state. Remote visuals do not damage or move the owner's character.

mounted_swimmer._comment: Rider draws from the mount after interpolation, never independent drifting transforms.

island_residency._comment: Mode3 is a testable initial choice, not measured performance acceptance. Average peer camera collision is insufficient for separate islands.

required_peer_scenarios: two human swimmers on separate islands
human drowning observed by remote peer
mounted swimmer with synchronized seated rider
one swimming peer while other fights in water
two clients race a dock unlock
Alpha defeat and catch both grant unique Swim Stone
Skill Candy belongs only to claimant and chosen skill
disconnect and reconnect mid-crossing without stamina reset
host in Meadows while client swims in Water
late join reconstructs Veilfall pumps and legendary aftermath
